details: Following the US Federal Reserve's decision to maintain interest rates, Bitcoin (BTC) experienced a dip, trading around $76,000 and showing a 2-3% decline in the last 24 hours. The Fed's stance, coupled with geopolitical tensions and rising Treasury yields, has led to a market-wide risk-off sentiment, resulting in over $500 million in leveraged long positions being liquidated across exchanges. This indicates that bulls were caught off guard by the market weakness.
title: Bitcoin Falls to $76K as Fed Holds Rates, Fueling Market Uncertainty

details: Ripple has announced the establishment of a new regional headquarters in Dubai's International Financial Center. This move signals the company's confidence in Dubai as a global blockchain hub and aims to meet the increasing demand for regulated blockchain-powered payment solutions across the Middle East and Africa. Ripple plans to expand its local team and further support clients and partners in the region, building on significant growth since its initial MEA presence in Dubai in 2020.
title: Ripple Opens New Regional Headquarters in Dubai for MEA Growth

details: Cryptocurrency exchange Gemini has secured a Derivatives Clearing Organization (DCO) license from the CFTC, advancing its efforts toward offering a full suite of CFTC-regulated products. This approval allows Gemini to expand its offerings, particularly in prediction markets and perpetual futures. Gemini shares saw a positive reaction, jumping over 6% following the announcement, reflecting investor confidence in the platform's expanded regulatory standing.
title: Gemini Gains CFTC Approval for Derivatives Clearing Organization License

details: Meta has implemented USDC stablecoin payouts for creators on its platforms, utilizing the Solana and Polygon blockchains via Stripe. This initiative aims to provide creators with faster, more efficient, and potentially lower-cost payment options. The integration of a leading stablecoin on prominent layer-1 and layer-2 networks marks a significant step towards broader adoption of digital assets in mainstream commerce and creator economies.
title: Meta Launches USDC Stablecoin Payouts for Creators on Solana & Polygon
